bc346fde1e.rewrite:
mov r9d,edx
shl r9d,0x1e
shrd r9d,ecx,0x6
shr r9d,0x12
add r9,QWORD PTR [rsi+0x10]
movzx r8d,WORD PTR [rsi+0x18]
test r8w,r8w
bc346fde1e.why: The shifts construct ((ecx & 0x3f) << 8) | ((edx & 3) << 6) directly in r9d, then add the original base load. MOVZX reproduces the zero upper bits of the final r8, and the unchanged word TEST preserves SF.
